description_en: Retrieves the details of a specific load balancer based on the specified site ID and load balancer ID
description_zh: 根据指定站点ID和负载均衡器ID，获取单个负载均衡器的详细信息
name: GetLoadBalancer

parameters.help_en: The load balancer ID, which uniquely identifies the load balancer to query. This ID is returned when the load balancer is created. You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2868897.html operation to obtain all load balancers under a site
parameters.help_zh: 负载均衡器ID，用于唯一标识要查询的负载均衡器，负载均衡器创建时会直接返回，也可以通 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2868897.html 接口获取站点下所有负载均衡器查询
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

schema.description_en: The data structure returned upon a successful response, which contains the detailed configuration of the load balancer
schema.description_zh: 成功响应时返回的数据结构，包含负载均衡器的详细配置信息

FailoverAcrossPools.description_en:
Indicates whether failover across origin pools is enabled.

true: Enabled.
false: Not enabled
FailoverAcrossPools.description_zh:
是否跨源地址池回源。

true：是。
false: 否

OriginLevelRetry.description_en: Specifies whether to retry the next IP address when back-to-origin fails and the origin server is a domain name that resolves to multiple IP addresses
OriginLevelRetry.description_zh: 回源失败时，若源服务器是域名且解析出多个IP，则重试下一个IP

DefaultPools.description_en: The list of default pool IDs

Description.description_en: The description of the load balancer
Description.description_zh: 负载均衡器的描述信息

Enabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the load balancer is enabled.

true: Enabled.
false: Not enabled
Enabled.description_zh:
负载均衡器是否启用。

true：启用。
false：不启用

FallbackPool.description_en: The fallback pool ID. When all other pools are unavailable, traffic is redirected to this pool
FallbackPool.description_zh: 兜底地址池ID，当所有其他地址池不可用时，流量将被重定向至此地址池

Id.description_en: The unique ID of the load balancer
Id.description_zh: 负载均衡器的唯一标识ID

ConsecutiveDown.description_en: The number of consecutive failed probes required to consider the check failed, such as `5`
ConsecutiveDown.description_zh: 连续探测多少次失败算失败，如`5`

ConsecutiveUp.description_en: The number of consecutive successful probes required to consider the check successful, such as `3`
ConsecutiveUp.description_zh: 连续探测多少次成功算成功，如`3`

ExpectedCodes.description_en: The expected status codes for a successful HTTP response, such as 200,202
ExpectedCodes.description_zh: 预期状态码，如200,202，成功的HTTP响应

FollowRedirects.description_en:
Indicates whether to follow redirects.

true: Yes.
false: No
FollowRedirects.description_zh:
是否跟随重定向。

true：是。
false：否

Header.description_en: The HTTP header information included in the probe request
Header.description_zh: 探测时所带头部信息，HTTP头

Interval.description_en: The health check interval. Unit: seconds
Interval.description_zh: 健康检查的间隔时间，单位：秒

MonitoringRegion.description_en:
The region where the probe nodes are located. Default value: Global.

Global: worldwide.
ChineseMainland: the Chinese mainland.
OutsideChineseMainland: worldwide (excluding the Chinese mainland)
MonitoringRegion.description_zh:
探测点所在区域，默认为Global，

Global: 全球。
ChineseMainland: 中国内地。
OutsideChineseMainland: 全球（不包括中国内地）

Timeout.description_en: The health check timeout period. Unit: seconds
Timeout.description_zh: 健康检查超时时间，单位：秒

Type.description_en: The monitor protocol type, such as HTTP, used for health checks. A value of off indicates that no health check is performed
Type.description_zh: 监视器协议类型，如HTTP，用于健康检查，值为off时，表示不进行检查

Name.description_en: The name of the load balancer

RandomSteering.description_en: The weighted round-robin configuration, which controls the traffic distribution weight across different pools
RandomSteering.description_zh: 加权轮询配置，用于控制不同地址池的流量分配权重

DefaultWeight.description_en: The default round-robin weight applied to all pools that do not have an individually specified weight. Valid values: 0 to 100
DefaultWeight.description_zh: 默认的轮询权重，用于所有没有单独指定权重的地址池。取值范围：0-100的数字

additionalProperties.description_en: The weight of a single origin pool. Valid values: 0 to 100. A value of 0 indicates that no traffic is routed to this origin pool
additionalProperties.description_zh: 单个源地址池的权重，0-100的数字，0表示不往该源地址池调度流量

PoolWeights.description_en: The weight configuration for each backend server pool. The key is the pool ID and the value is the weight coefficient. The weight coefficient represents the relative proportion of traffic distribution
PoolWeights.description_zh: 各后端服务器池的权重配置，键为池ID，值为权重系数。权重系数表示相对流量分配的比例

RegionPools.description_en: The pools mapped to primary regions

Rules.description_en: The list of rule configurations that define behaviors under specific conditions
Rules.description_zh: 规则配置列表，用于定义特定条件下的行为

items.description_en: The rule configuration in the rule set

FixedResponse.description_en: The fixed response content returned when the rule is matched
FixedResponse.description_zh: 匹配规则后执行响应指定内容

ContentType.description_en: The Content-Type field in the HTTP header

Location.description_en: The location field in the HTTP response

Overrides.description_en: The load balancing configuration overrides applied to matching requests. The configured fields override the corresponding fields in the load balancer configuration
Overrides.description_zh: 匹配规则后修改对应请求改写的负载均衡配置，配置的字段，会覆盖负载均衡器配置里相应的字段

Rule.description_en:
The rule content, which uses conditional expressions to match user requests. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
Match specific requests: Set the value to a custom expression, such as (http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
Rule.description_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")

RuleEnable.description_en:
The rule switch. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Valid values:
on: enabled.
off: disabled
RuleEnable.description_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

RuleName.description_en: The rule name. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration
RuleName.description_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数

Sequence.description_en: The rule execution order. A larger value indicates a higher priority
Sequence.description_zh: 规则执行顺序。数值越大越优先执行

Terminates.description_en:
Indicates whether to terminate the execution of subsequent rules.

true: Yes.
false: No. This is the default value
Terminates.description_zh:
是否终止执行后续规则。

true：是。
false：否，默认值

SessionAffinity.description_en:
The session persistence setting. Valid values:
off: disabled.
ip: IP-based session persistence.
cookie: cookie-based session persistence.
http_header: HTTP header-based session persistence
SessionAffinity.description_zh:
会话保持，取值：
off：不开启。
ip：按ip方式会话保持。
cookie: 按cookie方式会话保持。
http_header：按 http header 方式会话保持

SiteId.description_en: The ID of the site to which the load balancer belongs
SiteId.description_zh: 负载均衡器所归属的站点ID

Status.description_en: The status of the load balancer

SubRegionPools.description_en: The pools mapped to secondary regions. When multiple secondary regions share the same set of pools, you can concatenate multiple secondary regions with commas as the key
SubRegionPools.description_zh: 二级region对应的地址池，多个二级region共用一批地址池时，可以多个二级region，使用逗号拼接作为key

Ttl.description_en: The TTL value, which specifies the time-to-live of the DNS record. Default value: 30 seconds
Ttl.description_zh: TTL值，DNS记录的生存时间，默认为30秒
